baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative object at word 2, the Lord relation at word 3, and the dual denial verb at word 4 form a direct question to two addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal originates in sovereign care; the dual recipients are asked which concrete bestowals they classify as false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the question's objects and keep the reading attached to word 2.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the giver and ground the recipients' accountability.
Declaring a thing or report false gives the dual verb its explicit act of repudiation.

changed_reading.before: A generic rhetorical question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: A two-party demand to identify which acts of the Lord's bestowal they are willing to pronounce unreal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus roots permit capacity, formative care, and a charge that proves true or false through performance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor enables action, lordly care develops that capacity, and denial occurs behaviorally when the enabled charge is not carried through.

activation_trace.role: Capacity or ability recasts the questioned favors as powers placed at the recipients' disposal.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formation of the addressees.
A charge proves false by failing in execution, supplying the move from spoken denial to failed enactment.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only an opinion voiced about a benefit.
changed_reading.after: A recipient can falsify an enabling gift by failing to make its entrusted capacity true in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 has an oath branch, word 3 has a pact branch, and word 4 can name either repudiation or failure of a charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question briefly takes juridical form: an oath is bundled into the Lord's pact, and the pair must decide whether to disavow or breach it.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a form-distant but exact juridical image at the focus object.
A covenant bound like a bundle turns lordship into the party holding the pact together.
Fulfilling or failing a charge gives breach a practical test rather than leaving it at verbal disbelief.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks for mental acknowledgment of favors.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also sound like a covenant hearing: which binding grant will the two recipients repudiate by breach?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped target of word 2 offers a remainder or liability that follows its holder; the dual verb can test whether a charge is carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: What has been granted leaves a residual claim that follows both recipients; their ensuing response either honors that claim or makes it fail.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before turns each disclosed favor into an outstanding residue.
A liability or right that follows its holder gives the residue a relational claim on the pair.
Ownership and authority identify whose claim follows the recipients.
Failure to carry through supplies the possible falsification of that outstanding claim.

changed_reading.before: A favor is exhausted once received.
changed_reading.after: Every received favor leaves a claim that follows the two recipients into their next act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening mercy and womb images join the focus branches of favor and nurture, changing bestowal from a transferred object into a relation that brings forth, shelters, and develops life.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness establish the affective mode in which the later Lord's favors operate.
The womb supplies a generative enclosure, making favor a process of bringing forth rather than mere possession.
Nurture and completion connect the opening generative image directly to the focus Lord relation.
Bestowed favors remain the explicit focus anchor while their mode changes from inventory to care.

structural_cues: The surah opens with the mercy-root epithet before teaching and creation.
The focus asks about the favors of the same Lord rather than detached benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy, womb, favor, and nurture images. Reader arrow: generative mercy is the causal mode of the favors. Live alternative: the opening epithet may set tone without specifying how each favor is produced.

changed_reading.before: Which items in a stock of benefits are denied?
changed_reading.after: Which acts of being generated, sheltered, repaired, and brought toward completion are denied?

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic calculation and the commanded just scale make recognition an act of calibration; denial becomes undercounting, misvaluing, or short-delivering the reality of a favor.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning provide the quantitative frame within which favors can be honestly or falsely assessed.
The scale of justice makes proper valuation a moral operation rather than neutral observation.
Giving short measure supplies the concrete mechanism by which acknowledgment can be practically falsified.
A charge that fails in performance anchors short-measuring as enacted denial at the focus verb.
The favors are what the recipients must count and weigh without diminution.

structural_cues: Calculation in 55:5 leads into the repeated scale language of 55:7-9.
The ethical command not to diminish measurement precedes the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: counting, just weighing, and short measure. Reader arrow: these operations govern how the addressees recognize and answer favor. Live alternative: the scale passage may regulate commerce and justice without defining denial itself.

changed_reading.before: Denial means saying that a favor is not true.
changed_reading.after: Denial also means assigning creation too little weight and returning less truth in conduct than the received favor warrants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split-root images of following sequence and voice-after-voice become enacted by the clause's recurrence: each disclosure is followed by the same dual response test, making the refrain a recurring checksum on the preceding scene.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies the responsorial image for the first contextual occurrence of the refrain.
Following in sequence becomes a visible compositional operation immediately before the focus occurrence.
The next recurrence retests whether the addressees' response carries the newly disclosed charge through.
The focus occurrence turns every preceding disclosure into a right or claim that follows the pair.
The dual declaration of falsehood is the answer whose consistency the recurring checksum tests.

structural_cues: The packet contains thirty non-focus occurrences of the same four-word refrain around the focus occurrence.
55:30 follows the daily-affair statement and is itself followed by a direct summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact recurrence plus branches of sequence, responding voice, and failed charge. Reader arrow: recurrence functions as an answer-checking protocol after each scene. Live alternative: it may be emphatic or mnemonic repetition without a separate checksum function.

changed_reading.after: 55:30 is one pulse in an antiphonal protocol that repeatedly carries the Lord's claim forward and tests the pair's answer anew.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two wide currents are released into encounter yet held from transgression; their maintained interface yields something hidden and luminous. Favor is therefore productive differentiation, not featureless abundance.

activation_trace.role: Free release supplies motion and openness without itself specifying collapse of difference.
A connection standing between sides makes the boundary an active relation rather than a dead wall.
Transgressing a limit by aggression names the crossing that the paired currents do not perform.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the yield generated at the maintained interface.
Gleaming makes the hidden yield perceptible as an emergent sign.
The focus favor branch receives the boundary mechanism as one concrete mode of bestowal.

structural_cues: 55:19-20 sequence release, meeting, an in-between relation, and non-transgression.
55:22 then presents a valuable emergence from the paired waters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: release, encounter, maintained between, non-transgression, and emergence. Reader arrow: the held difference enables the yield. Live alternative: the yield may simply be juxtaposed with the boundary rather than caused by it.

changed_reading.before: A favor is an added object handed to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: A favor can be the generative constraint that lets unlike powers meet without erasure and produce a third good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Finite forms pass away while the Lord remains; universal asking is followed by renewed work in each span. The focus favors become ongoing responsive acts whose changing manifestations should not be mistaken for failed provision.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after persistence marks the transience of every received form.
Continuance contrasts the remaining source with the passing forms.
Asking and requesting supply the dependency to which ongoing lordly action may respond.
Repairing and doing work well turns each affair into active maintenance rather than static possession.
Nurture and completion anchor ongoing maintenance in the focus Lord relation.
The focus favors become successive acts of maintenance rather than a closed stock.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 move from universal passing to the remaining Lord, universal asking, and action in every time span.
55:30 directly closes that movement with the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: passing, remaining, asking, temporal recurrence, and affair as repaired work. Reader arrow: the affairs answer dependency and continuously renew favor. Live alternative: asking and affair may be concurrent descriptions without a stated request-response arrow.

changed_reading.before: The questioned favors are durable things already possessed.
changed_reading.after: The questioned favors are the Lord's continuously renewed acts amid the disappearance of every temporary form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, attention turns to the two weighty recipients and tests ability, passage, and authority. The focus branches of capacity and incumbent action make the refrain a hinge from recognition to accountable execution.

activation_trace.role: Directing oneself to a matter supplies the abrupt concentration on the addressees after the focus.
Weight against lightness gives the dual recipients burden and consequence.
Ability and capacity echo the focus capacity branch and expose whether power is actually possessed.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the attempted execution and its limit.
Compelling proof makes passage dependent on authorization rather than autonomous capacity.
Capacity at the focus object makes ability itself one of the contested grants.
The formula of incumbency converts acknowledgment into an obligation to answer and act.
Lordly authority identifies the source of both the capacity and its jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 55:30 stands between action in every affair and the direct dual summons of 55:31.
The dual grammar of the focus continues into the address and capacity challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concentrated attention, weight, ability, attempted passage, and compelling authority. Reader arrow: the refrain transfers granted capacity into accountable obligation. Live alternative: 55:31 may begin a separate threat unit rather than complete the function of 55:30.

changed_reading.before: The question asks for gratitude while leaving agency untouched.
changed_reading.after: The question is a jurisdictional summons: which granted capacities will the pair deny when those capacities are called into accountable action?

context_deltas.mechanism: Later transformations turn inner denial into visible condition: an outward trace, recognition by an effect, and a mark disclosing state culminate in the very object formerly denied becoming present.

activation_trace.role: A favor's visible trace makes the transformed surface evidentiary rather than merely decorative.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies the epistemic move from hidden stance to readable condition.
A mark from which condition is inferred gives denial a bodily or situational signature.
The contextual act of declaring the encountered reality false closes the evidence sequence.
A patterned surface that deceives by its condition anchors the possibility that denial is enacted as misleading appearance.
The favors remain the reality whose trace is either read or cosmetically contradicted.

structural_cues: 55:37 changes the sky's visible condition; 55:39 removes ordinary questioning; 55:41 replaces it with recognition by marks.
55:43 names the denied object as immediately present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: transformed surface, recognition by sign, readable marks, and explicit denial. Reader arrow: the denier's condition itself becomes an answer to the refrain. Live alternative: the sequence may concern evidence at judgment without treating appearance as the mechanism of denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a private proposition that can remain hidden.
changed_reading.after: Denial can become a visible mismatch between reality and the condition one performs, until the condition itself answers the question.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus dual is echoed by paired sources and joined counterparts. The two recipients are not merely parallel individuals; each can function as the other's co-witness to one differentiated economy of favor.

activation_trace.role: A spring as a source of flowing water gives each garden a visibly productive point of issue.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes pairedness relational rather than merely numerical.
Abundant gushing differentiates another paired source while preserving the repeated twofold pattern.
A responding voice that follows another lets the dual recipients answer as counterparts rather than a fused audience.
The dual declaration is tested jointly, so either voice can expose the other's false classification.

structural_cues: The focus marks both Lord relation and denial with dual morphology.
The surah repeatedly organizes seas, horizons, gardens, springs, and fruits in twos.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: explicit counterpart imagery, paired sources, and dual grammar. Reader arrow: each addressee becomes co-witness and answering counterpart for the other. Live alternative: the dual may simply address two species without assigning reciprocal witness roles.

changed_reading.before: Two separate hearers happen to receive the same question.
changed_reading.after: The pair are questioned as counterparts whose differing voices jointly witness, or jointly falsify, one field of favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about good being met by good activates the focus covenant and following-claim branches: a gift is not a closed transfer but solicits a fitting return in action.

activation_trace.role: Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the return path from received good to responsive good.
Good action appears on both sides of the question, making response enacted rather than merely verbal.
A right following its holder gives the received favor a continuing claim without making the exchange symmetrical.
The pact image binds originating favor and responsive conduct into one relation.
A charge that fails in execution identifies non-response as practical falsification.

structural_cues: 55:60 is itself an interrogative about enacted return and is followed immediately by the refrain at 55:61.
The recurring refrain repeatedly places response after disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recompense, good action on both sides, following right, and pact. Reader arrow: favor calls for a fitting enacted return. Live alternative: 55:60 may state divine recompense only, without making human response part of the focus question.

changed_reading.before: Favor flows one way and asks only to be noticed.
changed_reading.after: Favor originates with the Lord yet carries a non-symmetrical claim for the recipients to answer good with fitting good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close joins stable growing good to the Lord's honored generosity. It retroactively distinguishes transient manifestations from a bestowal whose source persists and whose good continues to increase.

activation_trace.role: Stable, growing good provides the final mode of the favors questioned throughout the surah.
Honored generosity identifies increase as gift rather than impersonal accumulation.
Staying and lasting attach persistence to the focus Lord relation.
Nurture and completion explain how stable good can remain dynamically generative.
The focus favors receive their closing definition as persistent, growing beneficence.

structural_cues: 55:27 and 55:78 repeat the branchless j-l-l phrase; it is used only as uncited framing.
The final ayah reunites blessing, name, Lord relation, and honored generosity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: stable growing good, honored generosity, lasting, and nurture, with a repeated branchless closing phrase. Reader arrow: the final doxology specifies the durable mode of the earlier favors. Live alternative: the close may praise the Name without defining the refrain's object.

changed_reading.before: Passing benefits are denied when they cease to remain in hand.
changed_reading.after: Transient forms can pass while the underlying favor remains a stable, growing action of the enduring Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it depends on the non-dominant split target and its last-breath image; still valid because word 2 anchors that target and 55:26-27 immediately activate passing and remainder; downstream prose should present it only as a mortality-charged lexical echo, not as the surface translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus object can activate last breath, remainder, and following liability, while the focus verb tests whether the resulting charge has been fulfilled.

activation_trace.role: The last-breath image places the focus question at the terminal edge of agency.
A remainder after what came before supplies what survives for final accounting.
A charge fulfilled or failed lets a completed life answer the question by performance.
Cessation after persistence activates the terminal reading immediately before the focus.
The remainder image distinguishes what follows the dying recipient from what passes away.

changed_reading.before: Which benefits do you deny during ordinary possession?
changed_reading.after: At the last breath, what remaining claim follows you, and has your completed action made that claim true or false?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it builds a provisioning model from milk, syrup, flow, and blessing branches far from the focus forms; still valid because the focus denial branch explicitly names supply that fails expected duration and the focus Lord branch names nutritive repair; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy about expectation, never a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denial verb can image milk that disappears sooner than expected, while the Lord root can image thick nourishment used for repair.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails an expectation of duration makes denial a judgment formed when provision seems not to last.
Thick syrup used in repair gives lordly nurture a dense material analogue.
The favor branch keeps the analogy about provision attached to the questioned object.
Continuing provision activates duration and flow as the criterion under dispute.
Milk taken from a kneeling camel completes the packet's material provisioning chain.

changed_reading.before: A lapse in supply proves that the favor was false.
changed_reading.after: The refrain probes whether recipients call provision false whenever its flow does not match their expected timing or form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it combines a beautiful-bitter plant, deceptive patterned cloth, unstable variegation, and precious patterned carpets; still valid because both focus object and focus denial verb carry those exact material images and later display imagery reactivates them; downstream prose should retain it only as an appearance-versus-truth resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus object has a plant image whose appearance and taste diverge, while the focus denial verb has a cloth image that deceives by its condition.

activation_trace.role: A fair-looking but bitter plant makes the questioned gift resistant to judgment by appearance alone.
Variegated cloth that deceives by appearance turns falsehood into a misleading surface.
The Lord root's plant branch keeps the plant resonance connected across all three focus roots.
Variegation without stability activates the risk of reading changing display as settled truth.
Precious patterned carpets intensify the later context's crafted visual surface.
The same context root's pure-lie branch places falsity inside the display field rather than outside it.

changed_reading.before: Visible attractiveness or immediate sweetness is enough to identify a favor as true.
changed_reading.after: The refrain can test whether the pair confuses surface, taste, or stability with the deeper truth of what has been given.

strongest_changes: Denial moved from verbal disbelief to practical short-measuring and failure to carry an entrusted capacity through.
The exact recurrence activated a sequenced call-and-response checksum in which each scene leaves a claim for the pair's next answer.
The immediate passing-remaining-asking-affair sequence changed favors from possessed objects into continuously renewed acts.
The post-focus summons made capacity itself a granted favor under authority and accountability.
Later recognition by marks allowed denial to become a visible performed condition rather than a hidden proposition.
summary.what_was_special: 55:30 is both a repeated refrain and a hinge: it closes universal dependence and ongoing action in 55:26-29, then opens direct dual accountability in 55:31-33. Its split focus inventories keep conventional favor-denial alive beside sequence, liability, oath, performance, duration, and appearance readings without forcing a single resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence, liability, voice, and last-breath readings depend on a non-dominant mapped target and should remain exploratory.
The packet juxtaposes universal asking and ongoing affair but does not state that each affair is caused by a particular request.
55:31 may begin an independent section, weakening the claim that 55:30 itself performs the transition into summons.
The material provisioning and appearance models are exact branch activations but remain analogical and form-distant.
